name: Landing page generator
tagline: Writes a sales page for your product and puts it online with checkout wired up
description: Aimed at one specific business rather than being a generic page builder. You hand over the product and what you charge for it; it drafts the persuasive copy, assembles the page and pushes it to a real URL. The prices shown are your actual prices, and the buy button is connected rather than decorative.
author: ColinMcDermott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
